title: Finance Hash Fix - Deterministic Deduplication
description: Fixes non-deterministic USAA transaction hash that caused duplicate imports. New hash uses account_id|date|amount|original_description (no balance). Includes rehash script to clean existing duplicates and recompute all hashes.
author: Ka'tuar'el + Claude
changes: importer.py v4: make_hash() no longer includes balance in USAA hash
importer.py v4: both Sunmark and USAA use identical hash algorithm
rehash_transactions.py: removes duplicates from existing data
rehash_transactions.py: recomputes all hashes to v4 algorithm
rollback: Revert importer.py from git. Hashes in DB will be v4 format — existing imports will re-run as new (no data loss).
validation: total transactions == unique hashes after rehash
re-importing an archived CSV produces 0 new rows (all skipped as dupes)
